questions.enonce_markdown: Draw a large labelled diagram of the male reproductive system. *(8 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
*The diagram has to be drawn by the candidate.* A large, clear drawing in side view (or front view) of the male reproductive system, with a **title** ("Male reproductive system of man") and straight label lines.

**Elements to draw**
- **Scrotum** (a sac of skin outside the body) containing two **testes** (where sperm are made).
- **Epididymis**, a coiled tube on top of each testis (stores sperm).
- **Sperm duct (vas deferens)**: a tube from each epididymis going up and over the **ureter** into the abdomen to join the urethra.
- **Seminal vesicle** and **prostate gland** joined to the sperm ducts near the urethra (they add fluids to form semen); **Cowper's (bulbo-urethral) gland**.
- **Urinary bladder** above, with the **ureter** entering it.
- **Urethra**, running from the bladder through the **penis** to the outside (carries both urine and semen).
- **Penis**, with the **glans** at the tip covered by the **foreskin**.

**Labels expected** (at least 8): testis, scrotum, epididymis, sperm duct, seminal vesicle, prostate gland, urethra, penis, bladder, ureter.

questions.enonce_markdown:
Define the following;

(i) Reproduction.

(ii) Fertilization.

(iii) Pollination.

(iv) Copulation. *(8 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) Reproduction** is the **production of new individuals (offspring) of the same species** by living organisms, so that the species **continues to exist**.

**(ii) Fertilization** is the **fusion of the nucleus of a male gamete with the nucleus of a female gamete** (for example sperm and ovum) to form a **zygote**.

**(iii) Pollination** is the **transfer of pollen grains from the anther to the stigma** of a flower of the same species (by wind, insects or other agents).

**(iv) Copulation** (mating) is the act in which the male **places his penis in the vagina of the female** and releases **semen** containing sperm near the cervix, so that **internal fertilization** can take place.

questions.enonce_markdown:
Where does meiosis occur in

(i) Flowering plants.

(ii) Mammals. *(4 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(i) In flowering plants**, meiosis occurs in the **flower**: in the **anthers** (pollen mother cells in the pollen sacs, which give pollen grains with male haploid nuclei) and in the **ovules inside the ovary** (embryo sac mother cell, which gives the haploid egg cell).

**(ii) In mammals**, meiosis occurs in the **gonads (sex organs)**: in the **testes** (seminiferous tubules, forming sperm) of the male and in the **ovaries** (forming ova) of the female.
